name: recruitment-officer-decline-returns-looked-at-cards
notes: Recruitment Officer (1x97n2jnlt): "[Class Bonus] Foster. On Foster: Look at the top five cards of your deck. You may reveal an ally card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest of the cards on the bottom of your deck in any order." Declining the optional reveal must still put the rest -- i.e. every card it looked at -- on the bottom of the deck. Regression: RecruitmentOfficerOnFoster() queued the paired CUSTOM 'RecruitmentOfficerPick' decision without dontSkipOnPass, so ExecuteStaticMethods() skipped the handler when the player answered PASS and RecruitmentOfficerCleanup() never ran: the looked-at card(s) stayed in the temp zone and the deck was short (7 instead of 8). Incidental, NOT fixed here: RecruitmentOfficerOnFoster()'s look loop calls MZMove($player,'myDeck-0',...) repeatedly, which only ever moves the first card (the removed slot stays at index 0), so it looks at 1 card instead of 5. Same initial state and first three actions as recruitment-officer-class-bonus-on-foster-look-top-5 (a GUARDIAN champion supplies the Class Bonus; pass-pass-decline-materialize reaches player 1's recollection phase); only the final answer differs (PASS instead of revealing the ally).

rulesClauses: You may reveal an ally card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest of the cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. RecruitmentOfficerOnFoster() queued the CUSTOM 'RecruitmentOfficerPick' decision without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the optional reveal (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods() skip the handler; RecruitmentOfficerCleanup() never ran and the looked-at card stayed stranded in the temp zone (deck 7 instead of 8). Fix: dontSkipOnPass:1 on that AddDecision.
